The '''Jacent Valley''' was a canyon located on the [[Markaran Plains]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. During the [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|occupation]] of Balmorra by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] maintained an outpost called [[Camp Jacent]] in the valley.
